## Reader and need

As a [reader], I need to [achieve an outcome], so that [benefit].

## Current gap

Which pages did you check, and where do they fall short?

## Proposed content

Outline what the page or change would cover and where it fits in the sidebar. Pages describe what Lumi does today, so leave out capabilities that aren't built yet.

## Acceptance criteria

List what a reader should be able to do after reading it.

## Additional context

Use fictional examples; do not include private customer data or credentials.
